name: aion-presence
description: Aion is how Codex becomes visually present. Codex does the reasoning and the work; while Aion is open you meet it as one embodied presence: a living particle body (a sphere, expressive eyes or a stick figure) that listens, reflects real activity, answers, gestures, and shows things as particles, 3D objects or high-fidelity cards. No API key, no second model.

interface.longDescription: Aion is the embodied interface of the Codex agent you are already using. Codex remains the intelligence; while Aion is open you talk to it as Aion: an immersive particle presence — the original sphere, expressive Aion Eyes, or an articulated stick figure that gestures and explains — that listens (locally), reflects meaningful work (thinking, reading, editing, testing, building), visibly answers, and presents information the best way for it: as its own body (portraits, heritage oval portraits, real terrain, constellations, Tao symbols, clocks, genuine 3D objects you can turn), as quiet high-fidelity cards (photographs, code, results), or both. Aion makes no model API calls and needs no API key.
